newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Electric Fuel Corp in U.S. research deal.
newsitem.headline: Electric Fuel Corp in U.S. research deal.

text.p: Electric Fuel Corp said on Tuesday it had signed an agreement with the research arm of the U.S. utility industry to study how to commercialise zinc-air batteries for electric vehicles.

The company, based in Jerusalem and New York, said in a statement it would gauge together with the Electric Power Research Institute the chances of introducing the batteries into the commercial vehicle market.

"Other aspects such as the economic feasibility of setting up a manufacturing infrastructure in the United States and assessing the environmental impact and performance of the battery in the field and laboratory will be studied," it said.
Zinc-air batteries can increase the range of electric cars but regeneration is more complicated because the zinc must be replaced in lieu of recharging.
